title: TonalEnergy Tuning Log Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tonalenergy:tuning
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by instrument_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when TonalEnergy tuning log data has stopped arriving for a given instrument name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per instrument name and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your TonalEnergy tuning log feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
